evidence.title: Object-Uni: A Unified Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Controllable Generation

summary: A new AI model, Object-Uni, has been developed to unify object-centric spatial reasoning and controllable generation, advancing capabilities in scene understanding and manipulation. The approach integrates spatial and semantic awareness to improve performance in complex visual tasks.
title: Researchers Introduce Object-Uni: A Unified AI Model for Object-Centric Spatial Understanding and Generation
